{{Quote|Dwarf opee sea killers!|Jar Jar Binks, upon witnessing Nink and Vink swimming out of their containement bubble|<ref name="RITC" />}}
'''Dwarf opee sea killers''' were a downsized [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Opee sea killer/Legends|opee]],<ref name="RITC" /> a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creature with [[Color/Legends|reddish orange]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]<ref name="Skin" /> that lived in the sweet [[Water/Legends|waters]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="RITC" /> and [[Aquilaris]].<ref name="SWE1R">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref> While the "[[Nanism|dwarf]]" opees were as heavily plated as their bigger counterparts, they were much rarer and measured less than half the size of the full-sized ones<ref name="RITC" />&mdash;which made them less than 10 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Length" /> They were in fact genetically incapable of growing any larger than that.<ref name="RITC" />

The [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility|zoo]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], the underwater [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] on Naboo, used to host two dwarf opees christened [[Nink (dwarf opee sea killer)|Nink]] and [[Vink]] until a Gungan named [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] accidentally released them into the [[City/Legends|city]] by deactivating their [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]].<ref name="RITC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dwarf opee sea killers appeared in [[Episode I Adventures 9: Rescue in the Core|''Rescue in the Core'']], the ninth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Adventures]]'' book series, which was written by [[Ryder Windham]] and released in [[2000]].<ref name="RITC" />
